pairs.registryProposal: authorization-audit assumes every denial has a caller channel identity to record; it is silent on the unattributable denial (unknown/revoked token, no key row), which this repo uses as the stated reason to record nothing (src-tauri/src/mcp_server/auth.rs:75). The technique should say what an unattributed denial carries (origin, token-prefix fingerprint, correlation handle) so 'no identity' cannot read as 'nothing to audit'.
